bench.name: Barbell Bench Press
bench.view: Strict side view with the head toward the viewer's left
bench.kit: a flat padded weight bench and a barbell with round plates, seen from the side
bench.a: lying on the back on the bench with both feet flat on the floor, bar lowered to touch the lower chest, elbows bent
bench.b: same position, arms pressed straight up and locked, bar directly over the shoulders

incline.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
incline.view: Strict side view facing the viewer's right
incline.kit: an incline bench set at 45 degrees and a pair of dumbbells
incline.a: sitting back on the incline bench, feet on the floor, dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows bent
incline.b: same position, arms pressed straight up above the shoulders holding the dumbbells

fly.name: Cable Fly
fly.kit: two tall cable towers, one on each side of the character, with handles on thin cables
fly.a: standing between the towers with arms open wide out to the sides at chest height, elbows slightly bent, one handle in each hand
fly.b: same stance, both hands brought together in front of the chest, cables pulled across

dips.name: Parallel Bar Dips
dips.view: Strict side view facing the viewer's right
dips.kit: parallel dip bars on two posts, feet not touching the floor
dips.a: supported at the top with arms locked straight, hands on the bars, knees slightly bent
dips.b: body lowered between the bars with elbows bent to 90 degrees, torso leaning slightly forward

ohp.name: Standing Overhead Press
ohp.a: standing tall with feet shoulder width, bar resting at the collarbones, hands just outside shoulders, elbows bent
ohp.b: same stance, arms locked straight overhead, bar directly above the head

lateral.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
lateral.a: standing tall, arms down at the sides holding the dumbbells
lateral.b: same stance, both arms raised straight out to the sides to shoulder height, elbows very slightly bent

rear.name: Bent-Over Rear Delt Fly
rear.a: bent forward at the hips with a flat back and soft knees, arms hanging straight down holding the dumbbells
rear.b: same bent-over position, both arms raised out to the sides until level with the back

shrug.name: Dumbbell Shrug
shrug.a: standing tall, arms straight at the sides holding the dumbbells, shoulders relaxed
shrug.b: same stance with arms still straight, shoulders pulled straight up toward the ears

cgbench.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
cgbench.view: Three-quarter side view so the narrow grip is clearly visible, head toward the viewer's left
cgbench.kit: a flat padded weight bench and a barbell with round plates
cgbench.a: lying on the back on the bench, feet flat on the floor, hands close together at shoulder width, bar lowered to the lower chest with elbows tucked to the ribs
cgbench.b: same position, arms pressed straight up and locked, hands still close together

curl.name: Barbell Curl
curl.view: Strict side view facing the viewer's right
curl.a: standing tall, arms straight down, bar resting at the thighs with palms facing forward
curl.b: same stance, elbows pinned at the sides, forearms curled up so the bar is at shoulder height

incurl.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
incurl.view: Strict side view facing the viewer's right
incurl.kit: an incline bench set at 60 degrees and a pair of dumbbells
incurl.a: sitting back on the incline bench, arms hanging straight down behind the torso holding the dumbbells
incurl.b: same position, upper arms still hanging, forearms curled so the dumbbells reach the shoulders

hammer.name: Hammer Curl
hammer.kit: a pair of dumbbells held vertically, palms facing each other
hammer.a: standing tall, arms straight at the sides, thumbs facing forward
hammer.b: same stance, elbows pinned at the sides, forearms curled so the vertical dumbbells reach the shoulders, thumbs up

pushdown.name: Triceps Pushdown
pushdown.view: Strict side view facing the viewer's right
pushdown.kit: a tall cable tower directly in front of the character with a short straight bar on a thin cable
pushdown.a: standing close to the tower, elbows pinned at the sides, forearms level at chest height holding the bar
pushdown.b: same stance, elbows still pinned, arms pushed straight down so the bar is at the thighs

ohext.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
ohext.view: Strict side view facing the viewer's right
ohext.kit: one dumbbell held with both hands
ohext.a: standing tall, upper arms pointing straight up beside the ears, elbows bent, dumbbell lowered behind the head
ohext.b: same stance, arms straightened overhead, dumbbell directly above the head

farmer.name: Farmer Carry
farmer.view: Three-quarter side view walking toward the viewer's right
farmer.a: walking tall with chest up, arms straight at the sides carrying the dumbbells, left foot stepping forward
farmer.b: same posture, right foot stepping forward

chinup.name: Chin-Up
chinup.kit: a pull-up bar on two tall posts
chinup.a: hanging from the bar with arms straight, palms facing the character, feet off the floor
chinup.b: pulled up with the chin above the bar, elbows bent and pointing down, feet off the floor

pulldown.name: Lat Pulldown
pulldown.view: Strict side view facing the viewer's right
pulldown.kit: a lat pulldown machine with a seat, thigh pad, tall frame and a wide bar on a thin cable
pulldown.a: seated with thighs under the pad, arms reaching straight up holding the wide bar
pulldown.b: same seat, chest up, bar pulled down to the upper chest with elbows down and back

row.name: Barbell Row
row.view: Strict side view facing the viewer's right
row.a: hinged forward at the hips about 45 degrees with a flat back and soft knees, arms straight down, bar hanging below the shoulders
row.b: same hinged position, bar pulled up to the lower ribs, elbows behind the body

cablerow.name: Seated Cable Row
cablerow.view: Strict side view facing the viewer's right
cablerow.kit: a low cable machine with a long low bench, foot plate and a handle on a thin cable
cablerow.a: sitting tall with feet on the plate and knees soft, arms reaching straight forward holding the handle
cablerow.b: same seat, back upright, handle pulled to the stomach, elbows behind the body

facepull.name: Cable Face Pull
facepull.view: Strict side view facing the viewer's right
facepull.kit: a tall cable tower with a rope attachment at head height
facepull.a: standing with feet staggered, arms reaching straight forward at face height holding the rope
facepull.b: same stance, rope pulled toward the forehead with elbows high and flared out

deadlift.name: Deadlift
deadlift.view: Strict side view facing the viewer's right
deadlift.kit: a barbell with large round plates
deadlift.a: bar on the floor over the middle of the feet, hips low, flat back, chest up, arms straight, hands gripping the bar
deadlift.b: standing tall with hips and knees locked, shoulders back, arms straight, bar at the top of the thighs

squat.name: Back Squat
squat.view: Strict side view facing the viewer's right
squat.kit: a barbell with round plates resting across the upper back behind the neck
squat.a: standing tall, feet flat, hands gripping the bar on the shoulders
squat.b: deep squat with thighs parallel to the floor, flat back leaning slightly forward, knees over toes, heels down

rdl.name: Romanian Deadlift
rdl.view: Strict side view facing the viewer's right
rdl.a: standing tall, arms straight, bar at the thighs
rdl.b: hips pushed far back, torso hinged almost parallel to the floor with a flat back, knees only slightly bent, arms straight, bar at mid shin

legpress.name: Leg Press
legpress.view: Strict side view with the head toward the viewer's left
legpress.kit: a 45 degree leg press machine with a padded backrest, rails and a large foot platform
legpress.a: seated back in the machine with feet on the platform, legs pressed nearly straight
legpress.b: same seat, knees bent deeply toward the chest, platform lowered down the rails

legcurl.name: Lying Leg Curl
legcurl.view: Strict side view with the head toward the viewer's left
legcurl.kit: a lying leg curl machine with a padded bench and an ankle roller pad
legcurl.a: lying face down on the bench holding the handles, legs straight, ankles under the roller
legcurl.b: same position, knees bent so the heels come up toward the hips, roller lifted

calf.name: Standing Calf Raise
calf.view: Strict side view facing the viewer's right
calf.kit: a low wooden step and a pair of dumbbells
calf.a: standing with the balls of the feet on the edge of the step, heels dropped below it, arms holding dumbbells at the sides
calf.b: same place, risen high up on the toes, heels well above the step, legs straight

lunge.name: Walking Lunge
lunge.view: Strict side view facing the viewer's right
lunge.a: standing tall with feet together, arms at the sides holding the dumbbells
lunge.b: a long step forward, torso upright, front knee bent 90 degrees over the ankle, back knee just above the floor

hang.name: Hanging Leg Raise
hang.view: Three-quarter side view facing the viewer's right
hang.kit: a pull-up bar on two tall posts
hang.a: hanging from the bar with arms straight, legs straight down, feet off the floor
hang.b: still hanging with arms straight, both straight legs raised forward until level with the hips

plank.name: Plank
plank.view: Strict side view with the head toward the viewer's right
plank.kit: a thin exercise mat under the character
plank.a: on the forearms and toes, elbows under the shoulders, body in one straight line from head to heels
plank.b: the same plank held with abs and glutes visibly tight, body in the same straight line

crunch.name: Kneeling Cable Crunch
crunch.view: Strict side view facing the viewer's right
crunch.kit: a tall cable tower with a rope attachment at the top, and a thin mat
crunch.a: kneeling facing the tower, torso upright, hands holding the rope beside the ears
crunch.b: same kneeling spot, torso curled down so the elbows reach toward the thighs, hips stay still, rope still beside the ears

twist.name: Russian Twist
twist.kit: one dumbbell held in both hands, and a thin exercise mat
twist.a: seated on the mat leaning back slightly, knees bent, feet just off the floor, torso rotated to the viewer's left with the dumbbell beside that hip
twist.b: same seat, torso rotated to the viewer's right with the dumbbell beside the other hip

backext.name: Back Extension
backext.view: Strict side view facing the viewer's right
backext.kit: a 45 degree back extension bench with hip pad and ankle pad
backext.a: hips on the pad, ankles locked, arms crossed on the chest, torso bent down toward the floor with a flat back
backext.b: same place, torso raised until head, back and legs form one straight line, arms crossed on the chest
